content.value: Norus is an elite architectural firm and luxury real estate developer

specializing in premium residential estates, high-end apartment complexes, and sustainable urban living designs. The studio delivers turnkey development solutions—ranging from architectural concept design to premium property management—tailored for high-net-worth investors and luxury home buyers.
The objective of this project was to convert a bespoke, static HTML design into a fully functional, high-converting

. While HubSpot utilizes a native drag-and-drop module system, a standard template setup could not support the complex spatial hierarchy, fine typography, and premium micro-interactions required by the brand. The technical task required building custom HubSpot modules injected
with advanced HTML, inline CSS, and tailored JavaScript scroll animations,
giving marketing teams an easy drag-and-drop workflow without losing the site's high-end, cinematic feel.

The primary challenge lay in bridging the gap between HubSpot's visual drag-and-drop limitations and the fluid, animation-heavy requirements of a luxury brand. High-end real estate buyers expect a digital experience that reflects the precision of physical architecture. Standard CMS modules often limit layout flexibility and smooth transition behaviors. The development strategy required splitting the landing page into a fully customizable, reusable design system while maintaining smooth asset loading and high-performance JavaScript execution.
architecture to guide users through the luxury development funnel:
The page launches with an atmospheric, full-bleed hero banner (
) backed by a dynamic multi-column architectural project ledger. Custom CSS overlays were engineered to keep typography crystal clear over complex rendering shadows.
To show off active sites like
, the middle of the funnel utilizes an interlocking image grid. JavaScript scroll triggers were built in to gently fade and expand image containers as users scroll, mimicking a premium lookbook.
Deep in the funnel, the page transitions to a featured property spotlight layout (
). This module links structured data tokens directly to a customized HubSpot form, creating a smooth path for users to request pricing guides instantly.

Rather than relying on generic, locked fields, the layout was broken down into custom HubSpot modules using HubL (HubSpot Markup Language) variables. This allows non-technical content managers to swap out high-resolution property renders, modify pricing text, or update bullet points while keeping the strict layout boundaries perfectly intact.

The dark-mode setting relies on a rich charcoal and gold palette. Custom CSS grid styles and flexbox rules were written to handle the overlapping text elements, fine border metrics, and subtle hover effects on project cards. This custom styling bypasses the default layout limits of HubSpot's visual editor, ensuring pixel-perfect responsiveness across mobile and desktop screens.

To elevate the user experience, lightweight JavaScript animations were integrated into the template. The development utilizes the Intersection Observer API to detect user scroll positions, triggering elegant fade-ins for text blocks and a smooth parallax effect on large building renders. This approach gives the page a fluid, immersive feel without adding heavy external library bloat.

The core portfolio showcase uses a dynamic, multi-height masonry layout. Custom HTML containers were engineered within HubSpot to wrap the structural images securely, allowing the browser to render varying aspect ratios seamlessly while maintaining consistent spacing boundaries on all viewports.
) features a customized HubSpot form container styled with custom CSS. Default browser form fields were replaced with sleek, translucent inputs and a distinct gold submission CTA button (
) to match the premium architectural aesthetic. This ensures high-value user data streams directly into the internal CRM system without interrupting the luxury design language.
